scope_limits: Checked every cited ID against the 2022-02-15 frozen feed (title, source, timestamp) and every number against the 2022-02-15 card or a same-paragraph headline. The Super Bowl, its ads and the Coinbase app outage are known at this cutoff; Russia's claimed partial pull-back, the Duma appeal and Airbnb/Roblox/Upstart results (15 February) are not mentioned, and n1502 (troop-withdrawal item stamped 14 February) and the rolling 'Russia invades Ukraine' photo page are not cited. CNN 'Photos: Russia invades Ukraine' is a rolling photo page stamped 14 February that describes the invasion, an event after every February cutoff before 24 February; it cannot be pre-cutoff evidence.
